referenceIsolation.zh: 所附图片仅用于参考画风：只提取画家的笔触、光影、用色与整体视觉语言；不要复制或延续参考图中的任何主体、人物、构图、场景或故事。画面内容完全以你的主题为准。
referenceIsolation.en: Use the attached image only as a style reference. Extract only the painter's brushwork, lighting, palette, and overall visual language. Do not copy or carry over any subject, figure, composition, setting, or story from the reference image. The image content follows your theme only.
